t_advice_summary_textbox.text: pay attention to the colors of the gnomes (as opposed to the hat/style/dress) and take note of which colors lead to which forests (light or dark), as one leads to more mushrooms theoretically.

vb_textbox.text: What you need to know off the bat is that the gnomes are always in fixed pairs: orange and brown, green/pink, red/yellow, blue/purple. Their positions may vary, but they’ll always be in the same pairs. Each gnome within a pair will lead you to a different forest; one to a bright forest with a re basket, and one to a darker forest with a yellow basket. The orange, green, red, and blue gnomes guide you to the bright one, and the brown, pink, yellow, and purple ones take you to the darker one. The number of mushrooms in each forest changes, but try to keep track of the link between gnome and their forest to help you find the forests that contain the most mushrooms. And since your goal is to find the most mushrooms, pay extra close attention on the 5x rounds! Good luck!
